findings.title: Missing Defensive HTTP Security Headers (4 missing)
findings.observation: The web server response does not include standard defensive headers: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), Content-Security-Policy (CSP), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.evidence: Response headers from https://example.com/ were inspected. Found: {"hsts":null,"csp":null,"xFrameOptions":null,"xContentTypeOptions":null,"referrerPolicy":null,"permissionsPolicy":null}
findings.impact: Leaves the website vulnerable to clickjacking (missing X-Frame-Options), MIME-type sniffing, and cross-site scripting risks.

executiveSummary.summary:
This comprehensive website audit evaluates the digital presence, user experience, and technical foundation of https://example.com/ (ABC Interiors in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu). 
Based on 1 crawled pages and DOM inspection, the website demonstrates a foundational web presence with clear strategic opportunities to elevate brand authority, mobile engagement, and lead generation velocity.

Key immediate priorities include strengthening on-page conversion funnels, optimizing meta descriptions and heading hierarchy for search visibility, and modernizing visual design tokens with higher visual contrast and modern UI components.
